expectations.text: addresses-multikey-coordination-cost: the review addresses the coordination cost of this 14-key script on default flags (io vs shard-local) and the --lock_on_hashtags trade-off
expectations.evidence: Section 0: 'On default flags a shared hashtag does not co-locate keys on one shard - placement is by full key name, so this is regime (a), io-coordinated ... 26.95 us ... versus 1.01 us shard-local [lab Q5][S1]'. Trade-off stated: one tag vs 4 proactor threads means --lock_on_hashtags 'would serialise the whole workload behind one shard - it buys 26.95 to 1.54 us/call and pays for it by queuing every unrelated operation on that tag', kept as a two-arm experiment only.
